name: Dareka Ore o Koroshite Kudasai.
original_name: 誰か俺を殺してください。
source:
There's not a single person in this classroom who would save me.
They pretend not to see me, or maybe they're just like me.
Not even teachers will help; there must be something wrong with this world.
...that's what I honestly thought.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/9780]Freem![/url]]
